CustomField.label: Risk Reason
CustomField.description: Plain-language reason for the risk score, listing each signal that added points (for example: missed 2 classes in the last 2 weeks; no classroom login in 5 days). Blank when the score is 0. Written by the nightly scoring flow. Origin: SCA-4 / SCA-11.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Why the student was flagged, in plain words.
